title_selected: Alabama Tried to Execute an Innocent Man for 30 Years
description:
For thirty years, the state of Alabama prepared to execute Anthony Ray Hinton for two murders he did not commit. His conviction rested on discredited ballistics testimony and a defense that could not afford a qualified expert. This is how an innocent man survived death row — and how the Equal Justice Initiative and a unanimous U.S. Supreme Court (Hinton v. Alabama, 2014) finally set him free.

Chapters: the arrest and the alibi · the collapse of the trial · thirty years in a cell · the reversal.

Prime Documentary tells rigorously researched stories about justice and the law. This film includes AI-generated imagery used for illustration only; it is not authentic archival footage and depicts no real, identifiable individuals. Sources: U.S. Supreme Court opinion in Hinton v. Alabama (2014), the Equal Justice Initiative, court records, and public reporting.
